`createSilkApp` to have glass from the first frame. WebGPU copies the backdrop without a back
buffer, so there the glass shows from the first frame. The pane stays axis aligned: scale it
freely, but do not rotate it.

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blur` | 18 | Backdrop blur radius |
| `refraction` | 14 | How far the rim bends the backdrop (negative bends inwards) |
| `dispersion` | 0.35 | Colour split at the rim, 0 to 1 |
| `bevel` | 22 | Width of the curved rim |
| `frost` | 0.06 | Milky whitening, 0 to 1 |
| `saturation` | 1.2 | Colour boost of what shows through |
| `tint`, `tintAmount` | white, 0.04 | Coloured glass |
| `lightAngle`, `light` | top left, 0.8 | Where the sheen and the lit rim come from, and how bright |
| `grain` | 0.035 | Film grain |
| `shadow` | 0.3 | Soft shadow under the pane |

Live demo `glass-prism` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Glass } from 'pixi-silk/glass';
import { fan, ray, spectrum } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const mono = (text: string, size = 10, alpha = 0.7) =>
    new Text({
        text,
        style: { fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: size, fill: 0xffffff },
        alpha,
    });
const COLORS = spectrum(8);

export default defineDemo({
    size: [720, 440],
    background: 0x000000,
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        spread: { type: 'range', label: 'spread', min: 0.2, max: 1.2, step: 0.01, value: 0.62 },
        frost: { type: 'range', label: 'frost', min: 0, max: 40, step: 1, value: 14 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const beam = new SilkGraphics();
        const rainbow = new SilkGraphics();
        const glass = new Glass({
            width: 230,
            height: 200,
            radius: 30,
            refraction: 18,
            dispersion: 0.6,
            grain: 0.06,
            frost: 0.04,
            light: 1,
        });
        const hit = new SilkGraphics();
        const centre = { x: 360, y: 220 };
        let source = { x: 90, y: 420 };

        beam.blendMode = 'add';
        rainbow.blendMode = 'add';
        glass.position.set(centre.x - 115, centre.y - 100);
        glass.content.addChild(mono('2025 Edition'), Object.assign(mono('Reflect wealth'), { x: 140 }));
        for (const t of glass.content.children) t.position.y = 16;
        glass.content.children[0].x = 18;
        const brand = mono('F1', 54, 0.55);

        brand.position.set(150, 120);
        glass.content.addChild(brand);
        hit.rect(0, 0, 720, 440).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.001 });
        stage.addChild(hit, beam, rainbow, glass);

        trackGesture(hit, {
            onDown: (p) => (source = { x: p.x, y: p.y }),
            onDrag: (p) => (source = { x: p.x, y: p.y }),
        });

        tick((t) => {
            const dx = centre.x - source.x;
            const dy = centre.y - source.y;
            const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
            const shimmer = 1 + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.04;

            glass.set({ blur: params.frost });
            beam.clear();
            ray(beam, { x0: source.x, y0: source.y, x1: centre.x, y1: centre.y, w0: 2, w1: 26 }).fill({
                color: 0xffffff,
                alpha: 0.35,
                blur: 14,
            });
            ray(beam, { x0: source.x, y0: source.y, x1: centre.x, y1: centre.y, w0: 1, w1: 8 }).fill({
                color: 0xffffff,
                alpha: 0.9,
                blur: 3,
            });
            beam.circle(centre.x, centre.y, 40).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.35, blur: 26 });

            rainbow.clear();
            fan(centre.x, centre.y, angle + 0.08, params.spread * shimmer, 620, COLORS.length, 18).forEach((r, i) => {
                ray(rainbow, r).fill({ color: COLORS[i], alpha: 0.5, blur: 24 });
                ray(rainbow, { ...r, w1: r.w1 * 0.45 }).fill({ color: COLORS[i], alpha: 0.6, blur: 4 });
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Light that adds up

Light does not cover what is under it, it adds to it. Set `blendMode = 'add'` on a graphics (Figma
calls it Plus lighter) and overlapping glows burn towards white. Blur does the rest: every
`SilkGraphics` fill takes a `blur`, so a soft glow is one ellipse.

`Aurora` rises light from the bottom of a box in three colours and drifts slowly.

```ts

const sky = new Aurora({ width: 200, height: 330, radius: 30, colors: [0x6f1bff, 0xee36ff, 0xffffff] });
```

Live demo `glow-aurora` (source):

```ts
import { Color, Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Aurora, hexLabel } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

/** The palette colour itself, lifted towards white when it is too dark to read on the chip. */
const readable = (c: number) => {
    const [r, g, b] = new Color(c).toArray();
    const lift = Math.max(0, 0.45 - (0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b)) * 1.6;

    return new Color([r + (1 - r) * lift, g + (1 - g) * lift, b + (1 - b) * lift]).toNumber();
};

const PALETTES: [number, number, number][] = [
    [0x6f1bff, 0xee36ff, 0xffffff],
    [0x1e06bb, 0x00c8ff, 0xffffff],
    [0x0ecd00, 0xaeff00, 0xffffff],
];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 470],
    background: 0x1c1d22,
    controls: {
        rise: { type: 'range', label: 'rise', min: 0.3, max: 0.9, step: 0.01, value: 0.62 },
        speed: { type: 'range', label: 'speed', min: 0, max: 3, step: 0.1, value: 1 },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const auroras = PALETTES.map((colors, i) => {
            const x = 40 + i * 240;
            const phone = new Container();
            const frame = new SilkGraphics();
            const aurora = new Aurora({ width: 200, height: 330, radius: 30, colors, ticker: silk.app.ticker });

            frame
                .roundRect(-10, -10, 220, 350, 38, 0.6)
                .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.45, blur: 18 })
                .roundRect(-10, -10, 220, 350, 38, 0.6)
                .fill(0x2a2b31)
                .stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.08, alignment: 'inside' });
            phone.position.set(x, 30);
            phone.addChild(frame, aurora);
            stage.addChild(phone);

            colors.forEach((c, j) => {
                const chip = new Container();
                const bg = new SilkGraphics();
                const label = new Text({
                    text: hexLabel(c),
                    style: { fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: 11, fill: readable(c) },
                });

                label.anchor.set(0.5);
                bg.roundRect(-33, -12, 66, 24, 7).fill({ color: c, alpha: 0.12 });
                chip.addChild(bg, label);
                chip.position.set(x + 34 + j * 70, 422);
                stage.addChild(chip);
            });

            return aurora;
        });

        tick(() => {
            for (const a of auroras) a.set({ rise: params.rise, speed: params.speed });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Live demo `glow-sunrise` (source):

```ts
import { Text, type TextStyleFontWeight } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Glass } from 'pixi-silk/glass';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const label = (text: string, size: number, color: number, weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '500') =>
    new Text({
        text,
        style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: size, fill: color, fontWeight: weight },
    });

export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 440],
    background: 0x260600,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const orb = new SilkGraphics();
        const core = new SilkGraphics();
        const glass = new Glass({
            width: 300,
            height: 130,
            radius: 26,
            blur: 26,
            refraction: 10,
            frost: 0.1,
            tint: 0x3a0a00,
            tintAmount: 0.12,
        });
        const eyebrow = label('WORK SPACE', 10, 0xffd9b8, '600');
        const title = label('Enable Efficient Teamwork', 20, 0xffffff, '600');
        const body = label('Create a culture of clarity across every project.', 12, 0xffd9b8);

        eyebrow.style.letterSpacing = 1.4;
        eyebrow.position.set(24, 26);
        title.position.set(24, 46);
        body.position.set(24, 86);
        glass.content.addChild(eyebrow, title, body);
        glass.position.set(170, 286);
        stage.addChild(orb, core, glass);

        tick((t) => {
            const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.03;
            const drift = Math.sin(t * 0.5) * 10;

            // shape 1: a red disc under layer blur 226
            orb.clear()
                .circle(320 + drift * 0.3, 170, 150 * breathe)
                .fill({ color: 0xe5400f, blur: 90 })
                .circle(320, 190, 110)
                .fill({ color: 0xff5a14, alpha: 0.55, blur: 50 });
            // shape 2: a yellow peanut under layer blur 140, and shape 3: the same with a
            // progressive blur, 100 at the top to 0 at the bottom, so it sits on a crisp horizon
            const peanut = (g: SilkGraphics) =>
                g.ellipse(310 + drift, 196, 92, 50).ellipse(330 + drift * 0.6, 228, 112, 46);

            core.clear();
            peanut(core).fill({ color: 0xffb21f, alpha: 0.7, blur: 60, spread: 10 });
            peanut(core).fill({ color: 0xffe14a, blur: { from: 48, to: 0.5, angle: Math.PI / 2 } });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Neon

`Glow` draws one shape as a stack of passes. `neon()` is the five-layer Figma recipe for a shape
about `size` wide. Two blooms go behind. The core has a gradient, coloured drop glows and a pale
inner shadow. A 60% white copy added on top burns the middle out, and a blurred white outline
finishes it.
`bolt()` and `drop()` add ready outlines. Any path works, since fills treat it as one shape.

```ts

const spark = new Glow({
    draw: (g) => bolt(g, -50, -70, 100, 140),
    layers: neon(0xffd60a, { size: 100 }),
});
```

Live demo `glow-neon` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bolt, Glow, neon } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const YELLOW = 0xffd60a;
const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';

export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 440],
    background: 0x0b0b09,
    controls: {
        intensity: { type: 'range', label: 'glow', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.05, value: 1 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const room = new SilkGraphics();

        // warm light spilling into the room, like the reference backdrop
        room.rect(0, 0, 760, 440).fill(
            radial(
                [
                    [0, 0x3a3410, 1],
                    [0.55, 0x15140c, 1],
                    [1, 0x0b0b09, 1],
                ],
                { center: [0.28, 0.4], radius: 0.75 },
            ),
        );

        // the bolt alone: about 120 wide, so the recipe runs at size 120
        const big = new Glow({ draw: (g) => bolt(g, -60, -84, 120, 168), layers: neon(YELLOW, { size: 120 }) });

        big.position.set(190, 220);

        // the ticket card
        const card = new Container();
        const back = new SilkGraphics();
        const ticket = new SilkGraphics();
        const ring = new SilkGraphics();
        const small = new Glow({ draw: (g) => bolt(g, -52, -74, 104, 148), layers: neon(YELLOW, { size: 104 }) });

        // translucent yellow folder behind the ticket
        back.roundRect(0, 0, 230, 250, 18, 0.6)
            .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.6, blur: 30, spread: 6 })
            .roundRect(0, 0, 230, 250, 18, 0.6)
            .fill({
                gradient: linear(
                    [
                        [0, 0x8a7d1c, 0.95],
                        [1, 0x4f4710, 0.95],
                    ],
                    { from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1] },
                ),
                innerShadow: { color: 0xfff6b0, alpha: 0.25, y: 1, blur: 1 },
            });
        small.position.set(118, 50);
        // the white ticket with a notch where the ring sits
        ticket
            .beginPath()
            .moveTo(14, 160)
            .lineTo(146, 160)
            .bezierCurveTo(160, 160, 160, 176, 176, 176)
            .lineTo(244, 176)
            .bezierCurveTo(252, 176, 258, 182, 258, 190)
            .lineTo(258, 300)
            .bezierCurveTo(258, 308, 252, 314, 244, 314)
            .lineTo(14, 314)
            .bezierCurveTo(6, 314, 0, 308, 0, 300)
            .lineTo(0, 174)
            .bezierCurveTo(0, 166, 6, 160, 14, 160)
            .closePath()
            .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.55, blur: 18, spread: 2 })
            .fill({
                gradient: linear(
                    [
                        [0, 0xf4f5f0, 1],
                        [1, 0xc9ccd2, 1],
                    ],
                    { from: [0, 0], to: [0.3, 1] },
                ),
                innerShadow: { color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.9, y: 1, blur: 0.5 },
            });
        for (let i = 0; i < 46; i++) {
            const w = [1, 2, 1, 3, 1, 2][i % 6];

            ticket.rect(22 + i * 4.6, 284, w, 12).fill({ color: 0x1d2a3a, alpha: 0.85 });
        }
        const title = new Text({
            text: 'Supercharged', // prose-ignore: copy from the design reference
            style: { fontFamily: font, fontSize: 23, fontWeight: '700', fill: 0x18181b },
        });
        const sub = new Text({
            text: 'Experience network speed\nlike never before',
            style: { fontFamily: font, fontSize: 11.5, fill: 0x52525b, lineHeight: 16 },
        });

        title.position.set(22, 222);
        sub.position.set(22, 252);
        ring.position.set(206, 172);
        card.addChild(back, small, ticket, ring, title, sub);
        card.position.set(445, 60);
        stage.addChild(room, big, card);

        let last = -1;

        tick((t) => {
            const flicker = 0.92 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 7.3) * Math.sin(t * 2.1);

            if (params.intensity !== last) {
                last = params.intensity;
                big.setLayers(neon(YELLOW, { size: 120, intensity: params.intensity }));
                small.setLayers(neon(YELLOW, { size: 104, intensity: params.intensity }));
            }
            big.alpha = flicker;
            ring.clear()
                .circle(0, 0, 30)
                .stroke({ width: 12, color: YELLOW, alpha: 0.75 * params.intensity, blur: 9, blend: 'add' })
                .circle(0, 0, 30)
                .stroke({ width: 3.5, color: 0xfff27a, blur: 0.8 })
                .circle(0, 0, 30)
                .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.9, blur: 3, blend: 'add' });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Live demo `glow-button` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { along, linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const W = 400;
const H = 128;

/** Point at `u` (0..1) around a pill centred at (0, 0), clockwise from the middle of its right end. */
function onPill(u: number): [number, number] {
    const r = H / 2;
    const straight = W - H;
    const total = 2 * straight + 2 * Math.PI * r;
    let d = (((u % 1) + 1) % 1) * total;

    if (d < Math.PI * r * 0.5) {
        const a = d / r;

        return [straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
    }
    d -= Math.PI * r * 0.5;
    if (d < straight) return [straight / 2 - d, r];
    d -= straight;
    if (d < Math.PI * r) {
        const a = Math.PI / 2 + d / r;

        return [-straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
    }
    d -= Math.PI * r;
    if (d < straight) return [-straight / 2 + d, -r];
    d -= straight;
    const a = -Math.PI / 2 + d / r;

    return [straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
}

/** The border as an open path: it starts at `u0` and stops short of closing, leaving a gap. */
function border(u0: number, gap: number): number[] {
    const out: number[] = [];
    const n = 220;

    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) out.push(...onPill(u0 + (i / n) * (1 - gap)));

    return out;
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [620, 360],
    background: 0x05061a,
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const room = new SilkGraphics();
        const button = new Container();
        const bloom = new SilkGraphics();
        const body = new SilkGraphics();
        const line = new SilkGraphics();
        const dust = new SilkGraphics();
        const label = new Text({
            text: 'Magic button',
            style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 34, fontWeight: '500', fill: 0xe4e2f4 },
        });
        // violet on the long run of the border, cooling to teal at its head
        const tube = along([
            [0, 0xffffff, 0],
            [0.08, 0xd9c8ff, 1],
            [0.55, 0xffffff, 1],
            [0.85, 0xc8f4ff, 1],
            [1, 0x7cf7e8, 0.9],
        ]);
        const halo = along([
            [0, 0x8b3dff, 0],
            [0.15, 0x9b4dff, 1],
            [0.5, 0x6d5bff, 1],
            [0.8, 0x3d8bff, 1],
            [1, 0x2ee6d6, 1],
        ]);
        const dots = Array.from({ length: 70 }, (_, i) => ({
            x: (((i * 0.618034) % 1) - 0.5) * 340,
            y: ((((i * 0.7548777 + 0.31) * 7) % 1) - 0.5) * 90,
            r: 0.6 + ((i * 31) % 10) / 10,
            p: i * 1.37,
        }));
        let hover = 0;
        let hot = 0;
        let burst = 0;
        let head = 0;

        room.rect(0, 0, 620, 360).fill(
            radial(
                [
                    [0, 0x1a1060, 1],
                    [0.6, 0x0a0a2c, 1],
                    [1, 0x05061a, 1],
                ],
                { center: [0.45, 0.5], radius: 0.8 },
            ),
        );
        bloom.blendMode = 'add';
        line.blendMode = 'add';
        dust.blendMode = 'add';
        label.anchor.set(0.5);
        button.position.set(310, 180);
        button.addChild(bloom, body, dust, line, label);
        button.eventMode = 'static';
        button.cursor = 'pointer';
        button.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => Math.abs(x) <= W / 2 && Math.abs(y) <= H / 2 };
        button.on('pointerover', () => (hot = 1));
        button.on('pointerout', () => (hot = 0));
        trackGesture(button, { onTap: () => (burst = 1) });
        stage.addChild(room, button);

        body.pill(-W / 2, -H / 2, W, H).fill({
            gradient: linear(
                [
                    [0, 0x1d1a8a, 1],
                    [1, 0x0f1150, 1],
                ],
                { from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1] },
            ),
            innerShadow: [
                { color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.45, y: 18, blur: 22, spread: 4 },
                { color: 0x8f7bff, alpha: 0.35, y: -2, blur: 6, blend: 'add' },
            ],
        });

        tick((t, dt) => {
            hover += (hot - hover) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
            burst = Math.max(0, burst - dt * 1.4);
            head += dt * (0.05 + hover * 0.12 + burst * 0.4);
            const glow = 0.8 + hover * 0.3 + burst * 0.7;
            const pts = border(head, 0.035);

            bloom
                .clear()
                .pill(-W / 2, -H / 2, W, H)
                .fill({ color: 0x5b3dff, alpha: 0.35 * glow, blur: 60, spread: 10 })
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 26, gradient: halo, alpha: 0.75 * glow, blur: 16 });
            line.clear()
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 12, gradient: halo, alpha: glow, blur: 4 })
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 5, gradient: tube, cap: 'round' })
                .polyline(pts)
                .stroke({ width: 3, gradient: tube, alpha: 0.6, blur: 1.5 });
            // a star of light sits on the head of the border
            const [hx, hy] = onPill(head + 0.965);

            line.circle(hx, hy, 18)
                .fill({ color: 0xbffff6, alpha: 0.5 * glow, blur: 14 })
                .star(hx, hy, 4, 28 * glow, 1.2, 0, 0)
                .fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.5, blur: 2 });
            dust.clear();
            for (const d of dots) {
                const a = (0.25 + 0.75 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 1.6 + d.p)) ** 4) * (0.5 + hover * 0.5 + burst);

                dust.circle(d.x, d.y, d.r).fill({ color: 0xc7d2ff, alpha: Math.min(1, a * 0.7), blur: 0.4 });
            }
            button.scale.set(1 + burst * 0.03);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Beams, waves and slices

`ray()` adds a tapered beam, `fan()` spreads several from one point and `spectrum()` colours
them. Blurred and added, they make prisms, spotlights and hero lights. The hero below is three
pinched paths with blur 50, 27 and 12. The wave is a white stroke with red, orange and blue copies
a few pixels off. The bolt is one shape cut into strips, each smeared sideways.

Live demo `glow-beams` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { along, linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bolt } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const W = 760;
const mono = 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace';

/** A beam pinched in the middle: full height `h` at both ends, `waist` at the centre. */
function hourglass(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, w: number, h: number, waist: number): SilkGraphics {
    const x0 = cx - w / 2;
    const x1 = cx + w / 2;
    const t = cy - h / 2;
    const b = cy + h / 2;

    return g
        .beginPath()
        .moveTo(x0, t)
        .bezierCurveTo(x0 + w * 0.22, cy - h * 0.1, cx - w * 0.12, cy - waist / 2, cx, cy - waist / 2)
        .bezierCurveTo(cx + w * 0.12, cy - waist / 2, x1 - w * 0.22, cy - h * 0.1, x1, t)
        .lineTo(x1, b)
        .bezierCurveTo(x1 - w * 0.22, cy + h * 0.1, cx + w * 0.12, cy + waist / 2, cx, cy + waist / 2)
        .bezierCurveTo(cx - w * 0.12, cy + waist / 2, x0 + w * 0.22, cy + h * 0.1, x0, b)
        .closePath();
}

function label(text: string, x: number, y: number, color: number, anchorX = 0): Text {
    const t = new Text({ text, style: { fontFamily: mono, fontSize: 10, fill: color } });

    t.anchor.set(anchorX, 0);
    t.position.set(x, y);

    return t;
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, 520],
    background: 0x050508,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        // 1. hero light: three hourglass layers with layer blur 100, 55 and 24, as in the Figma file
        const hero = new Container();
        const heroBg = new SilkGraphics();
        const beam = new SilkGraphics();
        const heroClip = new SilkGraphics();

        heroBg.roundRect(0, 0, W, 240, 18, 0.6).fill(0x05031a);
        heroClip.roundRect(0, 0, W, 240, 18, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
        beam.mask = heroClip;
        hero.addChild(heroBg, beam, heroClip);

        // 2. chromatic wave
        const wavePanel = new Container();
        const waveBg = new SilkGraphics();
        const wave = new SilkGraphics();
        const waveClip = new SilkGraphics();

        waveBg.roundRect(0, 0, 370, 260, 18, 0.6).fill(0x0b0b0c);
        waveClip.roundRect(0, 0, 370, 260, 18, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
        wave.mask = waveClip;
        wavePanel.addChild(waveBg, wave, waveClip);
        wavePanel.position.set(0, 260);

        // 3. the bolt cut into strips, each smeared sideways
        const speed = new Container();
        const card = new SilkGraphics();
        const strips = 14;
        const top = 58;
        const bh = 154;
        const paint = linear(
            [
                [0, 0xffc2a8, 1],
                [0.4, 0xe05bd0, 1],
                [1, 0x6a3df0, 1],
            ],
            { from: [1, 0], to: [0.15, 1] },
        );
        const arts: SilkGraphics[] = [];
        // the white core is brightest in the middle and lets the colour fringes show at the ends
        const core = along([
            [0, 0xffffff, 0.35],
            [0.5, 0xffffff, 1],
            [1, 0xffffff, 0.35],
        ]);

        card.roundRect(0, 0, 370, 260, 18, 0.6)
            .fill(0x0f0d0f)
            .roundRect(10, 10, 350, 240, 12, 0.6)
            .fill(
                radial(
                    [
                        [0, 0x241821, 1],
                        [1, 0x120f12, 1],
                    ],
                    { center: [0.55, 0.5], radius: 0.7 },
                ),
            )
            .stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.05, alignment: 'inside' });
        speed.addChild(card);
        for (let i = 0; i < strips; i++) {
            const art = new SilkGraphics();
            const clip = new SilkGraphics();
            const y = top + (i * bh) / strips;

            clip.rect(10, y, 350, bh / strips).fill(0xffffff);
            art.mask = clip;
            art.blendMode = 'add';
            speed.addChild(art, clip);
            arts.push(art);
        }
        speed.addChild(
            label('Test sample #07', 26, 24, 0x6b5866),
            label('Render complete', 344, 24, 0xd9a0b8, 1),
            label('Speed mode: ON', 26, 226, 0x6b5866),
            label('Render time: 400 ms', 344, 226, 0x6b5866, 1),
        );
        speed.position.set(390, 260);

        stage.addChild(hero, wavePanel, speed);

        tick((t) => {
            const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.06;

            beam.clear();
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 150, 900, 300 * breathe, 30).fill({ color: 0x6a4cff, blur: 50 });
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 150, 860, 220 * breathe, 14).fill({ color: 0xa48bff, blur: 27 });
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 150, 820, 120 * breathe, 4).fill({ color: 0xece6ff, blur: 12 });

            const pts = (dy: number) => {
                const out: number[] = [];

                for (let x = -20; x <= 390; x += 5) {
                    out.push(x, 128 + dy - Math.sin(x / 75 + 1.2 + t * 0.8) * 46 + x * 0.04);
                }

                return out;
            };
            const smooth = { smooth: 'catmull' as const };

            wave.clear()
                .polyline(pts(0), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 90, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.12, blur: 36, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(-19), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 9, color: 0xff2a14, alpha: 0.95, blur: 3.5, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(-12), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 9, color: 0xff9a1a, alpha: 0.95, blur: 3, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(13), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 9, color: 0x2a62ff, alpha: 1, blur: 3, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(0), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 20, gradient: core, blur: 2.5, blend: 'add' })
                .polyline(pts(0), smooth)
                .stroke({ width: 34, gradient: core, alpha: 0.45, blur: 9, blend: 'add' });

            arts.forEach((art, i) => {
                // longer smears in the middle of the bolt, a slow ripple through the strips
                const f = i / (strips - 1);
                const smear = 30 + 70 * Math.sin(Math.PI * f) * (0.75 + 0.25 * Math.sin(t * 2.4 + i * 0.7));

                art.clear();
                for (let k = 3; k >= 0; k--) {
                    bolt(art, 150 - smear * (k / 3), top, 120, bh).fill({
                        gradient: paint,
                        alpha: k === 0 ? 0.9 : 0.22,
                        blur: { from: 0.6 + k * 2, to: 10 + k * 6, angle: Math.PI },
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Live demo `glow-icons` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bolt, drop } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const S = 176;

interface Palette {
    lead: number;
    mid: number;
    deep: number;
    rim: number;
    accent: number;
}

const PALETTES: Record<string, Palette> = {
    violet: { lead: 0x56d8ff, mid: 0x5636ff, deep: 0x2a0d73, rim: 0xc8f6ff, accent: 0xff4060 },
    sunset: { lead: 0xffe45c, mid: 0xff5a36, deep: 0xc0129a, rim: 0xfff4c2, accent: 0xb43cff },
    ice: { lead: 0x8af4ff, mid: 0x2d7dff, deep: 0x5b2bff, rim: 0xeaffff, accent: 0x7c4dff },
};

type Draw = (g: SilkGraphics) => SilkGraphics;

/**
 * A big shape that runs off the tile, the direction its light travels (lead edge to trailing side)
 * and how far along its box the colour has faded out.
 */
const ICONS: [Draw, angle: number, reach: number][] = [
    // bolt, cut by the top and right edges, lit from its left notch
    [(g) => bolt(g, 34, -46, 168, 236), 0, 1],
    // a dome rising from the bottom right corner, lit along its rim
    [(g) => g.circle(S * 1.02, S * 1.04, S * 0.8), Math.PI / 4, 0.5],
    // a drop sitting on the bottom edge, lit from the left
    [(g) => drop(g, S * 0.5, S * 1.02, S * 0.4, S * 0.66), -Math.PI / 6, 1],
    // a zigzag wall, lit along its left edge
    [
        (g) =>
            g.poly([S * 0.96, -10, S * 0.3, S * 0.4, S * 0.74, S * 0.6, S * 0.5, S + 10, S + 10, S + 10, S + 10, -10]),
        0,
        0.8,
    ],
];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [440, 440],
    background: 0x08080a,
    controls: {
        palette: { type: 'select', label: 'palette', options: Object.keys(PALETTES), value: 'violet' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const arts: SilkGraphics[] = [];

        ICONS.forEach((_, i) => {
            const tile = new Container();
            const plate = new SilkGraphics();
            const clip = new SilkGraphics();
            const art = new SilkGraphics();
            const rim = new SilkGraphics();

            plate.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 42, 0.6).fill(
                radial(
                    [
                        [0, 0x16161c, 1],
                        [1, 0x0a0a0d, 1],
                    ],
                    { center: [0.3, 0.2], radius: 1.1 },
                ),
            );
            clip.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 42, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
            art.mask = clip;
            // a thin glassy rim on top of the art, brighter where the light is
            rim.roundRect(0.5, 0.5, S - 1, S - 1, 42, 0.6).stroke({
                width: 1.4,
                gradient: linear(
                    [
                        [0, 0xffffff, 0.32],
                        [0.5, 0xffffff, 0.06],
                        [1, 0xffffff, 0.2],
                    ],
                    { from: [0, 0], to: [1, 1] },
                ),
                alignment: 'inside',
            });
            tile.addChild(plate, art, clip, rim);
            tile.position.set(30 + (i % 2) * (S + 28), 30 + Math.floor(i / 2) * (S + 28));
            stage.addChild(tile);
            arts.push(art);
        });

        let last = '';

        tick(() => {
            if (params.palette === last) return;
            last = params.palette;
            const p = PALETTES[params.palette];

            ICONS.forEach(([draw, angle, reach], i) => {
                const art = arts[i];
                const dx = Math.cos(angle);
                const dy = Math.sin(angle);
                const from: [number, number] = [0.5 - dx * 0.5, 0.5 - dy * 0.5];
                const to: [number, number] = [0.5 + dx * 0.5, 0.5 + dy * 0.5];
                const body = linear(
                    [
                        [0, p.lead, 1],
                        [0.3 * reach, p.mid, 1],
                        [0.7 * reach, p.deep, 0.85],
                        [reach, p.deep, 0],
                    ],
                    { from, to },
                );

                art.clear();
                // bloom that spills past the lit edge
                draw(art).fill({ gradient: body, alpha: 0.45, blur: 20, spread: 6, blend: 'add' });
                // the body: crisp on the lit side, dissolving towards the trailing side
                draw(art).fill({ gradient: body, blur: { from: 0.8, to: 46 * reach, angle }, blend: 'add' });
                // the lit edge: a shadow pushed towards the trailing side leaves a bright band along the lead
                draw(art).fill({
                    color: 0x000000,
                    alpha: 0,
                    innerShadow: [
                        { color: p.rim, alpha: 0.8, x: dx * 4, y: dy * 4, blur: 1.5, blend: 'add' },
                        { color: p.lead, alpha: 0.45, x: dx * 16, y: dy * 16, blur: 9, blend: 'add' },
                    ],
                });
                // a warm or cool kick where the lit edge meets the tile
                art.circle(S * (0.5 - dx * 0.35), S * 0.98, 26).fill({
                    color: p.accent,
                    alpha: 0.35,
                    blur: 18,
                    blend: 'add',
                });
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Stacked shadows

Several blurred copies behind a shape read better than one big blur: a tight one for the edge, a
wide one for the light. Each is the shape grown by its spread and blurred by half its CSS blur.

Live demo `glow-shadows` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

/** CSS-style shadows: blur is the CSS blur radius (twice the gaussian sigma), `spread` grows the shape first. */
const STACKS: [blur: number, spread: number][][] = [
    [],
    [[8, 0]],
    [
        [8, 0],
        [32, 8],
    ],
    [
        [8, 0],
        [32, 8],
        [128, 32],
    ],
];
const S = 110;

export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 300],
    background: 0x0a0a0c,
    setup({ stage }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();

        g.blendMode = 'add';
        STACKS.forEach((stack, i) => {
            const x = 60 + i * 175;
            const y = 80;

            for (const [blur, spread] of stack) {
                g.roundRect(x, y, S, S, 26, 0.6).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.55, blur: blur / 2, spread });
            }
            g.roundRect(x, y, S, S, 26, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
            const label = new Text({
                text: stack.length ? stack.map(([b, s]) => (s ? `${b} / ${s}` : `${b}`)).join('  +  ') : 'no shadow',
                style: { fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: 10, fill: 0x8e8e93 },
            });

            label.anchor.set(0.5, 0);
            label.position.set(x + S / 2, 250);
            stage.addChild(label);
        });
        stage.addChildAt(g, 0);

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

# Charts

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/charts/
Section: UI widgets

> Anti-aliased line and area charts with monotone smoothing that never overshoots, fading gradient fills, dotted guides, bars and dots.

Live demo `area-chart` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const FILL = vertical(
    [
        [0, 0x0a84ff, 0.55],
        [1, 0x0a84ff, 0],
    ],
    { easing: 'smooth' },
);

export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 220],
    controls: {
        smooth: { type: 'toggle', label: 'monotone smoothing', value: true },
        dots: { type: 'toggle', label: 'dots', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const data = Array.from({ length: 13 }, (_, i) => 90 + Math.sin(i * 0.9) * 40);

        stage.addChild(g);
        tick((t) => {
            const pts = data.flatMap((v, i) => [30 + i * 35, v + Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 12]);
            const smooth = params.smooth ? ('monotone' as const) : undefined;

            g.clear();
            for (const y of [40, 90, 140]) g.line(20, y, 460, y).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x3a3a3c, dash: [2, 4] });
            g.line(20, 190, 460, 190).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x636366 });
            // area between the series and a baseline; stroke() right after draws its top line
            g.area(pts, 190, { smooth }).fill(FILL).stroke({ width: 2.5, color: 0x0a84ff, cap: 'round' });
            if (params.dots)
                for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i += 2)
                    g.circle(pts[i], pts[i + 1], 3.5)
                        .fill(0xffffff)
                        .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0x0a84ff });
        });
    },
});
```

## Areas

```ts
g.area(points, baseline, { smooth: 'monotone' });          // between a series and a y baseline
g.area(upperPoints, lowerPoints);                           // band between two series
```

`area()` fills the region under a series (or between two) with vertical columns. The columns tile
exactly and share edges without seams, so translucent fills stay uniform. The top and bottom edges
get analytic anti-aliasing.

Call `stroke()` right after to draw the series line on top:

```ts
const FILL = vertical([[0, 0x0a84ff, 0.55], [1, 0x0a84ff, 0]], { easing: 'smooth' });

g.area(points, 190, { smooth: 'monotone' }).fill(FILL).stroke({ width: 2.5, color: 0x0a84ff, cap: 'round' });
```

## Smoothing that respects the data

`smooth: 'monotone'` never overshoots. It uses Steffen's method, like d3's `curveMonotoneX`. Peaks
stay on the data points, and flat runs stay flat. Use `'catmull'` only for decorative curves. Silk
exports the `monotoneX()` helper if you need the resampled points.

## Guides, bars and dots

```ts
for (const y of [40, 90, 140]) g.line(20, y, 460, y).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x3a3a3c, dash: [2, 4] });
for (const [i, v] of values.entries()) g.roundRect(20 + i * 12, 190 - v, 8, v, 3).fill(0xffd60a);
for (const [x, y] of points) g.circle(x, y, 3.5).fill(0xffffff).stroke({ width: 2, color: 0x0a84ff });
```

## One gradient across many shapes

With `units: 'local'`, a gradient uses the graphics' coordinates instead of each shape's box. A row
of bars then samples one continuous ramp:

```ts
const HEAT = linear([[0, 0x30d158], [0.5, 0xffd60a], [1, 0xff453a]], { units: 'local', from: [0, 190], to: [0, 40] });

for (const [i, v] of values.entries()) g.roundRect(x(i), 190 - v, 8, v, 3).fill(HEAT);
```

The experiments at the end of this page are complete chart widgets built from these pieces: area charts, bar charts,
sparklines, heart-rate pills, ranges and gauges.

---

# Sharp text

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/
Section: UI widgets

> SilkText draws labels and readouts from a runtime SDF glyph atlas. Text stays crisp from 0.5x to 100x zoom, with outlines, glows and tabular numbers.

Live demo `sdf-text` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Graphics, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Left: PixiJS Text, a bitmap drawn once. Right: SilkText, distance fields drawn per pixel.
// Both zoom around the same point, from 1x to 100x.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 260],
    background: 0x0b0b0d,
    controls: {
        zoom: { type: 'range', label: 'zoom (log)', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.01, value: 0, unit: '' },
        auto: { type: 'toggle', label: 'animate', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const half = 260;
        const sides: Container[] = [];
        const style = { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: '600' as const };

        for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            const side = new Container();
            const mask = new Graphics().rect(i * half, 0, half, 260).fill(0xffffff);
            const make = (text: string, size: number, color: number) =>
                i === 0
                    ? new Text({ text, style: { ...style, fontSize: size, fill: color } })
                    : new SilkText({ text, ...style, fontSize: size, fill: color });
            const title = make('Zoom 42%', 13, 0xffffff);
            const body = make('Labels, readouts and editor text', 9, 0x8e8e93);
            const tiny = make('W 128  H 64', 6, 0x0a84ff);

            title.position.set(70, 112);
            body.position.set(70, 132);
            tiny.position.set(70, 146);
            side.addChild(title, body, tiny);
            side.mask = mask;
            sides.push(side);
            const caption = new Text({
                text: i ? 'SilkText' : 'Text',
                style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'system-ui' },
            });

            caption.position.set(i * half + 12, 10);
            stage.addChild(side, mask, caption);
        }
        stage.addChild(new Graphics().rect(half - 0.5, 0, 1, 260).fill(0x2c2c2e));
        const readout = new SilkText({
            ...style,
            fontSize: 12,
            fill: 0x8e8e93,
            tabularNumbers: true,
            anchor: { x: 1, y: 0 },
        });

        readout.position.set(508, 10);
        stage.addChild(readout);

        let t = 0;

        tick((_t, dt) => {
            if (params.auto) {
                t += dt;
                // ease in and out between 1x and 100x every 12 s
                params.zoom = 1 - Math.cos((t / 12) * Math.PI * 2);
            }
            const k = 10 ** params.zoom;
            // zoom into the "4" of the title
            const fx = 70 + 44;
            const fy = 112 + 9;

            sides.forEach((side, i) => {
                side.pivot.set(fx, fy);
                side.position.set(i * half + 130, 130);
                side.scale.set(k);
            });
            readout.text = `${k.toFixed(1)}x`;
        });
    },
});
```

## Why text blurs

PixiJS `Text` draws the string once into a canvas and shows it as a texture. Scale it up past its
resolution and you see the pixels. That is fine for a HUD, but not for labels on an infinite
canvas, where the reader zooms in to 300% and beyond.

`SilkText` from `pixi-silk/text` stores each glyph as a **signed distance field** instead: for every
texel, how far it is from the glyph's edge. The shader turns that distance into coverage for
every screen pixel, the same way SilkGraphics draws its shapes. The edge is computed, not
stretched, so it stays sharp at any zoom, rotation and device pixel ratio.

```ts

const label = new SilkText({
    text: 'Frame 1',
    fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif',
    fontSize: 13,
    fontWeight: 600,
    fill: 0xffffff,
    anchor: 0.5,
});

app.stage.addChild(label);
label.text = 'Frame 2'; // laid out again before the next frame
```

A text is one instanced draw call however long it is. Every text shares one atlas texture.

## Styles

Live demo `sdf-text-styles` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { horizontal, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Outline, glow, shadow, weight and a gradient all read the same distance field: no filters,
// still one draw call per text. Bottom left: small sizes at 1x, Text above SilkText.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 320],
    background: 0x101014,
    controls: {
        outline: { type: 'range', label: 'outline', min: 0, max: 6, step: 0.5, value: 3, unit: 'px' },
        glow: { type: 'range', label: 'glow', min: 0, max: 12, step: 0.5, value: 8, unit: 'px' },
        dilate: { type: 'range', label: 'weight', min: -1.5, max: 1.5, step: 0.1, value: 0, unit: 'px' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
        const card = new SilkGraphics()
            .roundRect(300, 176, 200, 124, 22, 0.6)
            .fill(0x1c1c1e)
            .roundRect(20, 176, 260, 124, 22, 0.6)
            .fill(0x1c1c1e);
        const outlined = new SilkText({
            text: 'OUTLINE',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 44,
            fontWeight: 900,
            fill: 0xffd60a,
            outline: { width: 3, color: 0x3a1c00 },
            shadow: { color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.6, blur: 6, offsetY: 4 },
        });
        const neon = new SilkText({
            text: 'Neon glow',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 40,
            fontWeight: 700,
            fill: 0xffe3f1,
            shadow: { color: 0xff2d92, blur: 8 },
        });
        const gradient = new SilkText({
            text: 'Gradient fill',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 30,
            fontWeight: 800,
            fill: horizontal(['#64d2ff', '#bf5af2', '#ff375f']),
        });
        const readout = new SilkText({
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 40,
            fontWeight: 600,
            fill: 0xffffff,
            tabularNumbers: true,
            anchor: { x: 1, y: 0 },
        });
        const unit = new SilkText({
            text: 'BPM  live',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 12,
            fontWeight: 600,
            fill: 0xff375f,
        });

        outlined.position.set(20, 20);
        neon.position.set(300, 26);
        gradient.position.set(20, 100);
        readout.position.set(480, 196);
        unit.position.set(320, 270);
        stage.addChild(card, outlined, neon, gradient, readout, unit);

        // small sizes at 1x: PixiJS Text above, SilkText below
        const sample = 'Hamburgefonstiv 0123';

        [11, 12, 13].forEach((size, i) => {
            const y = 190 + i * 34;
            const pixi = new Text({ text: sample, style: { fontFamily: font, fontSize: size, fill: 0xe5e5ea } });
            const silk = new SilkText({ text: sample, fontFamily: font, fontSize: size, fill: 0xe5e5ea });
            const tag = new SilkText({ text: `${size}px`, fontFamily: font, fontSize: 9, fill: 0x8e8e93 });

            pixi.position.set(64, y);
            silk.position.set(64, y + 15);
            tag.position.set(34, y + 9);
            stage.addChild(pixi, silk, tag);
        });

        tick((t) => {
            outlined.outline = params.outline > 0 ? { width: params.outline, color: 0x3a1c00 } : null;
            neon.shadow =
                params.glow > 0 ? { color: 0xff2d92, blur: params.glow * (0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(t * 3)) } : null;
            for (const text of [outlined, neon, gradient]) text.dilate = params.dilate;
            readout.text = (72 + 6 * Math.sin(t * 1.3) + 2 * Math.sin(t * 4.1)).toFixed(1);
        });
    },
});
```

Outlines, glows and shadows are cheap with distance fields: they are the same field read at a
different distance. No filters and no extra passes.

```ts

const title = new SilkText({
    text: 'BIG WIN',
    fontSize: 48,
    fontWeight: 900,
    fill: horizontal(['#ffd60a', '#ff9f0a']),
    outline: { width: 3, color: 0x3a1c00 },
    shadow: { color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.6, blur: 6, offsetY: 4 },
});
const readout = new SilkText({ text: '72.4', fontSize: 32, tabularNumbers: true });
```

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fontFamily`, `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `fontStyle` | system UI font, 16, 400, normal | Any CSS font. Size is free, glyphs are baked once |
| `fill` | white | A colour, or a linear, radial or conic gradient over the text box |
| `letterSpacing`, `lineHeight` | 0, font | Spacing in local units. Line height 0 uses the font's own |
| `align`, `wordWrap`, `wordWrapWidth`, `breakWords` | left, off, 100, off | Line layout, like PixiJS `Text` |
| `anchor` | 0 | Point of the text box at the position |
| `outline` | none | `{ width, color, alpha }`, outside the glyph edge |
| `shadow` | none | `{ color, alpha, blur, offsetX, offsetY }`. Without an offset it is a glow |
| `dilate` | 0 | Grows or thins the glyphs, in local units |
| `tabularNumbers` | off | Digits share one width, so changing numbers do not jitter |
| `kerning` | on | Pair kerning measured from Canvas |

Change one field with its setter (`label.fontSize = 18`) or several with `label.set({ ... })`.
Width, height, bounds and hit tests use the text box, as with PixiJS `Text`.

Outlines and glows can reach about a quarter of the font size. Past that, the distance field
runs out and the effect is clamped. For a wider halo, put a blurred SilkGraphics shape behind the text.

## Small sizes

At 11 to 13 px a texel of the atlas is smaller than a screen pixel. SilkText then averages four
samples per pixel instead of one, so thin strokes do not flicker or break up. The bottom left of the
demo above shows PixiJS `Text` and SilkText at 11, 12 and 13 px.

Weight and width match PixiJS `Text`, because the glyphs come from the same Canvas font and the
layout from the same `measureText`. Canvas text can be hinted to the pixel grid on some platforms,
so at 1x its stems can look a touch crisper. From 2x, and whenever the camera zooms, SilkText is the
sharper of the two.

## Widgets

`ValuePill` from `pixi-silk/ui/pill` takes a `label` option: a function that builds its text. Pass
`silkLabel()` for pills that sit under a zooming camera. The widget never imports SilkText on
its own, so apps that do not use it do not ship it.

```ts

const pill = new ValuePill({ label: silkLabel({ tabularNumbers: true }) });

pill.show('42 px');
```

To let people click and type into a text, wrap it in a `TextEditor`. [Editing text](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text/)
covers the caret, selection, input methods and undo.

## Fonts and the atlas

Glyphs are drawn with Canvas2D at 48 px the first time they appear, then turned into a distance
field. The atlas is one 8-bit texture, 1024 texels wide, that doubles in height up to 4096 as glyphs
arrive. When it is full it starts over, and every text bakes what it needs again.

Load web fonts before the first text uses them, for example with `document.fonts.load('600 16px Inter')`.
Glyphs baked while a font was still loading are baked again once it is ready.

For a different trade-off, make your own atlas and pass it to the texts that should use it:

```ts

const big = new SdfAtlas({ size: 64, radius: 24 }); // sharper corners when zoomed far in, longer glows
const heading = new SilkText({ text: 'Overview', fontSize: 40, atlas: big });
```

## Limits

- **Corners** round off slightly at extreme zoom. A single-channel distance field cannot hold a
  sharp corner. At 48 px the rounding is about a fiftieth of the font size.
- **Emoji and colour fonts** come out as one-colour silhouettes. Use PixiJS `Text` for them.
- **Shaping**: no ligatures, no right-to-left text and no combining marks. Each code point is one glyph.
  Latin, Greek and Cyrillic UI text works. Arabic and Indic scripts need PixiJS `Text`.
- **Kerning** is per pair, measured with `measureText`. It matches Canvas for Latin text.
- **Renderers**: WebGL2 and WebGPU. Pixi's WebGL1 fallback is not supported.

---

# Editing text

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editing-text/
Section: UI widgets

> TextEditor makes SilkText clickable and editable like a design tool text layer: caret, selection, undo, clipboard and input methods, sharp at any zoom.

Live demo `text-edit-canvas` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { bindHistoryKeys, History } from 'pixi-silk/history';
import { SilkText, silkLabel } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { Camera, ZoomControl } from 'pixi-silk/ui/camera';
import { TextEditor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/textedit';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Click a text to edit it, drag to select, double click a word. Pinch or ctrl + scroll to zoom in
// and keep typing: the caret, the selection and the glyphs stay sharp. Scroll pans.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 440],
    background: 0x151517,
    touchAction: 'none',
    ownsCamera: true,
    setup({ silk }) {
        const app = silk.app;
        const world = new Container();
        const camera = new Camera({ world, element: app.canvas });
        const zoom = new ZoomControl(camera, { label: silkLabel() });
        // one undo stack for the whole canvas: text edits sit in it with everything else
        const history = new History();
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';

        app.stage.addChild(world, zoom);

        const card = new SilkGraphics()
            .roundRect(0, 0, 420, 260, 28, 0.6)
            .fill(linear([0x2c2c30, 0x1c1c1f], { from: [0, 0], to: [0, 1] }))
            .roundRect(0.5, 0.5, 419, 259, 28, 0.6)
            .stroke({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.08, width: 1 });
        const caption = new SilkText({ text: 'Frame 1', fontFamily: font, fontSize: 11, fill: 0x8e8e93 });

        caption.position.set(2, -18);
        world.addChild(card, caption);

        const title = new TextEditor({
            text: 'Edit me',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 30,
            fontWeight: 700,
            fill: 0xffffff,
            multiline: false,
            history,
            element: app.canvas,
        });
        const body = new TextEditor({
            text: 'Text on an infinite canvas. Zoom to 800% and the caret is still one crisp pixel and a half wide.\n\nDouble click a word, triple click a paragraph.',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 15,
            lineHeight: 22,
            fill: 0xc7c7cc,
            width: 356,
            placeholder: 'Write something',
            history,
            element: app.canvas,
        });

        title.position.set(32, 30);
        body.position.set(32, 86);
        world.addChild(title, body);

        // a tiny caption follows the title as you type
        const count = new SilkText({ fontFamily: font, fontSize: 11, fill: 0x636366, tabularNumbers: true });

        count.position.set(32, 230);
        world.addChild(count);
        const update = () => {
            const words = body.value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;

            count.text = `${title.value.length} characters in the title, ${words} words below`;
        };
        const stops = [title.state.text.subscribe(update), body.state.text.subscribe(update), bindHistoryKeys(history)];

        update();
        const place = () =>
            zoom.position.set(app.screen.width - zoom.size[0] - 12, app.screen.height - zoom.size[1] - 12);

        app.renderer.on('resize', place);
        place();
        camera.fit({ x: -20, y: -40, width: 460, height: 320 }, 24, false);

        return () => {
            for (const stop of stops) stop();
            app.renderer.off('resize', place);
            title.destroy();
            body.destroy();
            camera.destroy();
        };
    },
});
```

## A text layer you can type into

`TextEditor` from `pixi-silk/ui/textedit` wraps a [SilkText](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/) with a caret, a selection
and keyboard input. It lives in the scene like any display object, so it pans and zooms with a
[camera](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/canvas-and-measurements/) and stays sharp at 800%.

```ts

declare const world: Container;
declare const canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;

const note = new TextEditor({
    text: 'Edit me',
    fontSize: 15,
    width: 320, // wraps at 320, grows in height
    placeholder: 'Write something',
    element: canvas,
});

note.on('change', (text: string) => console.log('saved', text));
world.addChild(note);
```

Click to place the caret, drag to select and Shift + click to extend. A double click selects a word
and a triple click its paragraph. Words come from `Intl.Segmenter`, so they follow the language.

## How typing works

The keys do not go to the canvas. On focus, the editor puts a hidden `<textarea>` on the page, right
at the caret, and keeps its text and selection in step with its own. The browser types into it, and
the editor applies each change.

That is why the platform's own text input works:

- **Input methods** for Japanese, Chinese and Korean, and dead keys for accents. The text being
  composed shows inline with an underline, and becomes one undo step when you confirm it.
- Mobile keyboards, autocorrect and the emoji picker.
- Copy, cut and paste, with the system clipboard.

The field follows the caret as you type, pan or zoom, so input method popups open next to the text.
Pass `element` (usually `app.canvas`) to place it. Without it, the editor uses the element of the first press.

## Keys

| Keys | What they do |
| --- | --- |
| Left, Right | Move by grapheme, so an emoji or an accented letter is one step |
| Option + Left / Right on Mac, Ctrl elsewhere | Move by word |
| Up, Down | Move by line, keeping the column you started from |
| Home, End, or cmd + Left / Right on Mac | Start and end of the line on screen |
| Shift with any of these | Extend the selection |
| cmd or ctrl + A | Select all |
| Backspace, Delete | Delete a grapheme, or a word with Option or Ctrl |
| Enter | A new line, or commit in a single-line field |
| cmd or ctrl + Enter | Commit and leave a multi-line field |
| Tab | Move to the next field, or insert a tab with `tab: 'insert'` |
| Escape | Leave the field |
| cmd or ctrl + Z, Shift + cmd or ctrl + Z | Undo and redo |

## Fields and forms

Live demo `text-edit-form` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { watch } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { TextEditor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/textedit';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Single-line fields drawn on the canvas. Tab moves to the next field, Enter in the last one sends
// the form. Japanese or Chinese input, dead keys and the emoji picker type into them as usual.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 330],
    background: 0x0f0f11,
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
        const fields: TextEditor[] = [];
        const stops: (() => void)[] = [];
        const field = (label: string, y: number, options: ConstructorParameters<typeof TextEditor>[0]) => {
            const row = new Container();
            const name = new SilkText({ text: label, fontFamily: font, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, fill: 0x8e8e93 });
            const box = new SilkGraphics();
            const editor = new TextEditor({
                fontFamily: font,
                fontSize: 15,
                fill: 0xf2f2f7,
                multiline: false,
                width: 276,
                element: silk.app.canvas,
                ...options,
            });

            editor.position.set(12, 31);
            // a press anywhere on the box focuses the field
            box.eventMode = 'static';
            box.cursor = 'text';
            box.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
                (e.nativeEvent as Event).preventDefault();
                editor.focus();
            });
            row.addChild(name, box, editor);
            row.position.set(40, y);
            // the box lights up while its field has focus
            stops.push(
                watch(editor.state.focused, (on) => {
                    box.clear()
                        .roundRect(0, 20, 300, 40, 10, 0.6)
                        .fill(on ? 0x1c1c22 : 0x18181b)
                        .roundRect(0, 20, 300, 40, 10, 0.6)
                        .stroke({ color: on ? 0x0a84ff : 0x3a3a3c, width: on ? 1.5 : 1, alignment: 'inside' });
                }),
            );
            stage.addChild(row);
            fields.push(editor);

            return editor;
        };

        const name = field('Name', 24, { placeholder: 'Ada Lovelace' });
        const email = field('Email', 104, { placeholder: 'ada@example.com' });
        const code = field('Promo code, 8 characters at most', 184, { placeholder: 'SILK2026', maxLength: 8 });
        const result = new SilkText({
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 12,
            fill: 0x30d158,
            wordWrap: true,
            wordWrapWidth: 150,
        });
        const button = new Container();
        const pill = new SilkGraphics().pill(0, 0, 140, 40).fill(0x0a84ff);
        const label = new SilkText({ text: 'Send', fontFamily: font, fontSize: 14, fontWeight: 600, anchor: 0.5 });

        label.position.set(70, 20);
        button.addChild(pill, label);
        button.position.set(360, 228);
        button.eventMode = 'static';
        button.cursor = 'pointer';
        result.position.set(360, 52);
        stage.addChild(button, result);
        const send = () => {
            const values = [name.value || 'no name', email.value || 'no email', code.value || 'no code'];

            result.text = `Sent\n${values.join('\n')}`;
            TextEditor.active?.blur();
        };

        button.on('pointertap', send);
        code.on('submit', send);
        // Enter in the first fields moves on, like a sign-up form
        name.on('submit', () => email.focus(true));
        email.on('submit', () => code.focus(true));
        stops.push(TextEditor.chain(fields));

        return () => {
            for (const stop of stops) stop();
            for (const f of fields) f.destroy();
        };
    },
});
```

With `multiline: false` the editor is an input. Enter commits instead of breaking the line. A
`width` clips the text and scrolls it to keep the caret in view. `TextEditor.chain()` links fields in
Tab order.

```ts

const email = new TextEditor({ multiline: false, width: 260, placeholder: 'ada@example.com' });
const code = new TextEditor({ multiline: false, width: 260, maxLength: 8 });

TextEditor.chain([email, code]);
code.on('submit', () => console.log(email.value, code.value));
```

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `multiline` | true | A text area, or a single-line input |
| `width` | none | Wraps a text area, clips and scrolls an input |
| `placeholder` | empty | Shown while the text is empty |
| `maxLength` | none | Longest text in UTF-16 code units, like `maxlength`. Never splits an emoji |
| `readOnly` | false | Selectable and copyable, not editable |
| `selectable` | true | False turns pointer input off |
| `enter` | `newline` or `commit` | `newline`, `commit` or `blur` |
| `tab` | `next` | `next` emits `tab` and leaves, `insert` types a tab |
| `history` | its own | A `HistoryLike` to share the app's undo stack |
| `theme` | blue | Caret, selection and underline colours |

Every SilkText style option works too: font, size, weight, fill, letter spacing, line height and alignment.

## Read-only text

Live demo `text-edit-readonly` (source):

```ts
import { SilkText } from 'pixi-silk/text';
import { TextEditor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/textedit';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A read-only paragraph: select with the mouse or a long press, cmd or ctrl + C copies.
// There is no caret and typing does nothing.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 260],
    background: 0x0b0b0d,
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const font = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif';
        const paragraph = new TextEditor({
            text: 'Release notes. Text layers now edit on the canvas. Selection, the clipboard and input methods go through a hidden text field, so they behave the way the platform does. Double click a word to select it.',
            fontFamily: font,
            fontSize: 15,
            lineHeight: 23,
            fill: 0xd1d1d6,
            width: 440,
            readOnly: true,
            element: silk.app.canvas,
            theme: { selection: 0xffd60a, selectionAlpha: 0.28 },
        });
        const readout = new SilkText({ fontFamily: font, fontSize: 12, fill: 0x8e8e93 });

        paragraph.position.set(40, 36);
        readout.position.set(40, 214);
        stage.addChild(paragraph, readout);
        const stop = paragraph.state.selection.subscribe(() => {
            const n = paragraph.selectedText.length;

            readout.text = n ? `${n} characters selected. Cmd or ctrl + C copies them.` : '';
        });

        return () => {
            stop();
            paragraph.destroy();
        };
    },
});
```

`readOnly: true` keeps clicking, selecting and copying, and drops the caret and editing. Use it for
release notes, logs or error messages that people want to copy.

## Events, signals and undo

The editor emits `focus`, `blur`, `input` on every edit, `change` when the text was committed with a
new value, `submit` on Enter in a single-line field, and `tab`. The same state is on
`editor.state` as [signals](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/selection-and-history/): `text`, `committed`, `focused`, `selection`
and `composing`.

Undo is built in. Consecutive typing folds into one step, and a click or an arrow key starts the
next. To put text edits in line with the rest of an editor, pass its history:

```ts

const history = new History();
const title = new TextEditor({ text: 'Frame 1', multiline: false, history });

bindHistoryKeys(history); // cmd + Z outside the field undoes text edits too
```

## Hit testing for other tools

The caret math is in the layout, so other tools can use it. `SilkText` has `caretAt(point)` for the
caret nearest to a local point. `caretRect(index)` gives where a caret sits and `rangeRects(from, to)`
the highlight boxes of a range. They follow wrapped lines, alignment, letter spacing, line height,
empty lines and trailing spaces. `pixi-silk/text` also exports the same functions on a `TextLayout`,
plus `graphemeStops`, `wordAt` and the word jumps.

```ts

const label = new SilkText({ text: 'Hello world', wordWrap: true, wordWrapWidth: 60 });
const hit = label.caretAt({ x: 30, y: 8 });
const caret = label.caretRect(hit.index, hit.upstream);

console.log(hit.index, caret.x, label.rangeRects(0, 5));
```

## Limits

- **Right-to-left and mixed direction text** is not supported. Arabic and Hebrew lay out left to
  right, and the caret moves in source order.
- **Emoji** count as one caret step, but draw as one-colour silhouettes, as in [SilkText](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/text/).
- **Shaping**: no ligatures and no combining marks drawn on their base letter. Each code point is a glyph.
- **Spell check** underlines are off: the hidden field is invisible.

---

# Hit testing & events

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/hit-testing/
Section: UI widgets

> Pointer events test each shape's real distance field: rings are hollow, lines react only within their stroke and rounded corners stay rounded.

Live demo `hit-test` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// containsPoint() evaluates the real distance field: the ring is hollow, the line is only its stroke.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 220],
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const items = [
            { draw: (g: SilkGraphics, c: number) => g.circle(100, 110, 60).stroke({ width: 18, color: c }) },
            { draw: (g: SilkGraphics, c: number) => g.roundRect(200, 50, 120, 120, 36, 0.6).fill(c) },
            {
                draw: (g: SilkGraphics, c: number) =>
                    g.polyline([350, 170, 390, 60, 450, 150]).stroke({ width: 10, cap: 'round', color: c }),
            },
        ].map((item) => {
            const g = new SilkGraphics();

            g.eventMode = 'static';
            g.cursor = 'pointer';
            stage.addChild(g);

            return { ...item, g, hover: false };
        });

        for (const item of items) {
            item.g.on('pointerover', () => (item.hover = true));
            item.g.on('pointerout', () => (item.hover = false));
        }
        tick(() => {
            for (const item of items) item.draw(item.g.clear(), item.hover ? 0x30d158 : 0x48484a);
        });
    },
});
```

Set `eventMode` and add listeners, as with any Pixi display object:

```ts
const button = new SilkGraphics();

button.eventMode = 'static';
button.cursor = 'pointer';
button.on('pointertap', () => console.log('tap'));
button.roundRect(0, 0, 160, 48, 24).fill(0x0a84ff);
```

`containsPoint()` first checks the object's bounds. Then it runs the shader's distance functions on
the CPU for the primitives under the pointer, last drawn first. A point is inside when its distance
to the painted region is negative:

- A stroked circle is a ring, so its centre is not inside.
- A line or polyline counts only within its stroke width.
- A rounded rect excludes the corners outside its radius.
- A blurred paint counts only up to its geometric edge.

You can also call it yourself:

```ts
if (g.containsPoint(g.toLocal(pointerGlobal))) { /* hovered */ }
```

In large interactive scenes, split independent targets into separate `SilkGraphics` objects. Then
each one hit-tests only its own primitives.

---

# Animation

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/animation/
Section: UI widgets

> Redraw SilkGraphics cheaply every frame. Animate with damp, dampAngle, Spring and ease so motion feels the same at 60, 120 or 144 Hz.

Live demo `spring` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, SilkGraphics, Spring } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Frame-rate independent motion: the knob glides the same at 60, 120 or 144 Hz.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 200],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        stiffness: { type: 'range', label: 'stiffness', min: 40, max: 400, step: 1, value: 170 },
        damping: { type: 'range', label: 'damping', min: 4, max: 40, step: 1, value: 14 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const hit = new Container();
        const x = new Spring(120);
        let glow = 0;
        let dragging = false;

        hit.eventMode = 'static';
        hit.hitArea = { contains: (px: number, py: number) => px >= 0 && px <= 480 && py >= 0 && py <= 200 };
        hit.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
            dragging = true;
            x.target = Math.min(440, Math.max(40, e.getLocalPosition(stage).x));
        });
        hit.on('globalpointermove', (e) => {
            if (dragging) x.target = Math.min(440, Math.max(40, e.getLocalPosition(stage).x));
        });
        hit.on('pointerup', () => (dragging = false));
        hit.on('pointerupoutside', () => (dragging = false));
        stage.addChild(g, hit);
        tick((_t, dt) => {
            x.stiffness = params.stiffness;
            x.damping = params.damping;
            x.step(dt);
            glow = damp(glow, dragging ? 1 : 0, 10, dt);
            g.clear();
            g.pill(40, 94, 400, 12).fill(0x2c2c2e);
            g.pill(40, 94, Math.max(12, x.value - 40), 12).fill(0x0a84ff);
            g.circle(x.value, 100, 22 + glow * 6).fill({ color: 0x0a84ff, alpha: 0.35 * glow, blur: 10 });
            g.circle(x.value, 100, 20).fill(0xffffff);
        });
    },
});
```

## Immediate mode is cheap

The simplest way to animate is to clear and redraw every frame. `clear()` keeps the GPU buffers.
Each primitive is 40 floats, and one instanced draw call renders them all:

```ts
app.ticker.add((ticker) => {
    const t = ticker.lastTime / 1000;

    g.clear();
    g.arcSweep(80, 80, 44, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 2 * (0.5 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t))).stroke({ width: 12, cap: 'round', color: 0x30d158 });
});
```

Put static parts in a second `SilkGraphics` and draw it once.

## Frame-rate independent motion

Easing by a fixed fraction per frame (`x += (target - x) * 0.1`) runs twice as fast on a 120 Hz
display. The helpers take the frame time instead:

```ts

x = damp(x, target, 10, dt);              // exponential approach, lambda is about 1 / seconds
angle = dampAngle(angle, target, 8, dt);  // shortest way around the circle

const spring = new Spring(0, 170, 26);    // value, stiffness, damping
spring.target = 1;
app.ticker.add((t) => draw(spring.step(t.deltaMS / 1000)));

ease.outCubic(0.5); // inOutCubic, outCubic, inOutSine, outExpo
```

`Spring.step()` integrates with fixed sub-steps, so it stays stable with large frame times.
`spring.settled` tells you when to stop redrawing.

## Sub-pixel motion

Slow-moving shapes glide instead of snapping from pixel to pixel. Silk renders coordinates exactly
as given, and `createSilkApp` turns off pixel rounding. The [sub-pixel lab page](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/04-subpixel/)
compares Silk with tessellated graphics.

---

# Radial menus and buttons

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/
Section: UI widgets

> Marking menus with nested rings, falloff and per-device tuning, plus buttons that animate in and out and ignore input while they move. Tree-shakeable.

Live demo `radial-menu` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import type { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkButton } from 'pixi-silk/ui/button';
import { bindRadialTrigger, type RadialItem, RadialMenu } from 'pixi-silk/ui/radial';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Vector icons: drawn once in white around (0, 0); the menu tints them.
type Icon = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => void;
const pointer: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.triangle(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.42, s * 0.34, s * 0.06, -s * 0.06, s * 0.16, 2).fill(0xffffff);
    g.line(-s * 0.02, s * 0.12, s * 0.16, s * 0.42).stroke({ width: s * 0.12, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
const move: Icon = (g, s) => {
    const r = s * 0.42;

    g.line(-r, 0, r, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.09, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.line(0, -r, 0, r).stroke({ width: s * 0.09, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 2;

        g.regularPoly(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, s * 0.14, 3, a + Math.PI / 2, 1).fill(0xffffff);
    }
};
const rotate: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.arcSweep(0, 0, s * 0.32, -Math.PI * 0.35, Math.PI * 1.6).stroke({
        width: s * 0.1,
        cap: 'round',
        color: 0xffffff,
    });
    g.regularPoly(s * 0.18, -s * 0.3, s * 0.14, 3, Math.PI / 2, 1).fill(0xffffff);
};
const scale: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.4, -s * 0.1, s * 0.5, s * 0.5, 3).stroke({ width: s * 0.08, color: 0xffffff });
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.42, s * 0.52, s * 0.52, 3).fill(0xffffff);
};
const gear: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.33).stroke({ width: s * 0.16, dash: [s * 0.13, s * 0.13], color: 0xffffff });
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.22).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, color: 0xffffff });
};
const more: Icon = (g, s) => {
    for (const x of [-1, 0, 1]) g.circle(x * s * 0.28, 0, s * 0.09).fill(0xffffff);
};
const heart: Icon = (g, s) => g.heart(0, 0, s * 0.8, 0.1).fill(0xffffff);
const star: Icon = (g, s) => g.star(0, 0, 5, s * 0.45, undefined, 0, 1.5).fill(0xffffff);
const plus: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.line(-s * 0.35, 0, s * 0.35, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.13, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.line(0, -s * 0.35, 0, s * 0.35).stroke({ width: s * 0.13, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};

const tools: RadialItem[] = [
    { id: 'select', label: 'SELECT', icon: pointer },
    {
        id: 'move',
        label: 'MOVE',
        icon: move,
        children: [
            { id: 'intuitive', label: 'Intuitive' },
            { id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' },
            { id: 'free', label: 'Free' },
        ],
    },
    {
        id: 'rotate',
        label: 'ROTATE',
        icon: rotate,
        children: [
            { id: 'uniform', label: 'Uniform' },
            { id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' },
            { id: 'free', label: 'Free' },
        ],
    },
    { id: 'scale', label: 'SCALE', icon: scale },
    { id: 'settings', label: 'SETTINGS', icon: gear, disabled: true },
    { id: 'more', label: 'MORE', icon: more },
];

// Press anywhere (or the round button) and drag to an item, or tap to keep the menu open.
// The `+` button opens a half ring that turns away from the edge it sits on.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 400],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        closeOnLeave: { type: 'toggle', label: 'close on leave', value: false },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const surface = new Container();
        const status = new Text({
            text: 'press, drag, release, or tap',
            style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13 },
        });
        const bounds = { x: 0, y: 0, width: 640, height: 400 };
        const report = (_item: RadialItem, path: readonly RadialItem[]) => {
            status.text = `picked  ${path.map((i) => i.id).join(' › ')}`;
        };
        const menu = new RadialMenu({ items: tools, bounds, ticker, onSelect: report });
        const quick = new RadialMenu({
            items: [
                { id: 'heart', label: 'LIKE', icon: heart },
                { id: 'star', label: 'FAVOURITE', icon: star },
                { id: 'plus', label: 'ADD', icon: plus },
                { id: 'more', label: 'MORE', icon: more },
            ],
            sweep: Math.PI * 0.9,
            innerRadius: 34,
            outerRadius: 92,
            bounds,
            ticker,
            onSelect: report,
        });
        const hub = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 64, icon: gear, iconSize: 28, ticker });
        const add = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 52, icon: plus, iconSize: 22, ticker });

        surface.eventMode = 'static';
        surface.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= 640 && y <= 400 };
        status.position.set(20, 18);
        hub.position.set(200, 210);
        add.position.set(586, 346);
        stage.addChild(surface, status, hub, add, menu, quick);

        bindRadialTrigger(surface, menu, { at: 'pointer' });
        bindRadialTrigger(hub, menu);
        bindRadialTrigger(add, quick);
        menu.state.hover.subscribe((item) => {
            if (item) status.text = `${menu.state.kind.value}: ${item.id}${item.disabled ? ' (disabled)' : ''}`;
        });

        tick(() => {
            menu.closeOnLeave = quick.closeOnLeave = params.closeOnLeave;
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Import only what you use

Each widget has its own entry point. Nothing else comes along: the menu does not pull in the button,
and `pixi-silk/signal` has no Pixi code at all.

```ts
```

## Radial menus

```ts

const menu = new RadialMenu({
    items: [
        { id: 'select', label: 'SELECT', icon: drawPointer },
        { id: 'move', label: 'MOVE', icon: drawMove, children: [{ id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' }, { id: 'free', label: 'Free' }] },
        { id: 'delete', label: 'DELETE', icon: drawTrash, disabled: true },
    ],
    sweep: Math.PI * 2, // Math.PI for a half ring
    bounds: { x: 0, y: 0, width: app.screen.width, height: app.screen.height },
    onSelect: (item, path) => console.log(path.map((i) => i.id).join(' > ')),
});

app.stage.addChild(menu);
bindRadialTrigger(toolButton, menu); // or menu.openAt(x, y, event)
```

How it behaves:

- **Marking.** Press, drag towards an item, release: picked in one gesture. A tap opens the menu
  and leaves it up for a second tap.
- **Angle, not hit boxes.** Past the dead zone the whole wedge counts, out to the falloff
  distance. A fast flick lands on its item even when the pointer overshoots the ring.
- **Hysteresis.** The current item holds until the pointer is clearly past its edge, so a shaky
  finger on a boundary does not flicker between two items.
- **It stays.** Moving away does not close the menu. Set `closeOnLeave` to close it after the
  pointer stays outside the falloff area for a grace delay.
- **Nested rings.** Items with `children` open the next ring around themselves, to any depth.
- **Edges.** Full rings slide inside `bounds`. Partial rings turn to face the inside instead.
